step_results.label: Get a full vehicle description
step_results.omission_consequence: Without make, color, and a plate or partial plate, the responding unit is looking for 'a car' in a parking lot full of cars.

step_results.label: Establish direction of travel
step_results.omission_consequence: A unit rolling in with no direction of travel is guessing which way to point the spotlight.

step_results.label: Confirm number and description of occupants
step_results.omission_consequence: Units need to know how many people to expect before they're standing at the window.
step_results.sop_citation: Call-Taking SOP 5.3 — occupant count and description.

step_results.label: Flag anything unusual for officer safety
step_results.omission_consequence: This step only triggers when the caller mentions something officers should know before contact; nothing here was missed by skipping it.

step_results.label: Confirm a working callback number
step_results.omission_consequence: If the unit needs more information after dispatch and the caller isn't reachable, the call stalls right when it needed a second look.

ballot.reflection_prompt: You cleared the vehicle description and had eyes on the occupants, but never got a direction of travel or a callback number. If units miss the vehicle on the first pass, what do you have left to redirect them with?

proves: the score and the ballot are unaltered since the timestamp
does_not_prove: the sim was not attempted before
scope.method: sha256 digest of the canonical JSON ballot object (score, verdict, and whatever fields the grading engine produced), bound to a stated timestamp inside the receipt body; hash-chained in arcaeon-ledger, one row per ballot.
